goal_summary: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the supplied operator. Use Member Inquiry to search by member number for the given member number and select that member. Start a Funds Transfer using the given from-share, to-share, amount, and memo, and click Continue to reach the review screen. On the review screen, before submitting, look at INTERACTIVE ELEMENTS for an element with kind 'hidden' (the security/transaction token) and extract its value using extract_mode=value and internal=true (it must never be a public output). Then click Post Transfer to submit. Declare the goal DONE once a confirmation is shown, recording the confirmation detail as a structured output if one is shown, using a suggested_success_condition grounded in stable page text (never a value you just extracted).
